attack_spec_document.note: Frozen after owner review of the calibration proposal (status proposal_ready_for_freeze_review). Thresholds UNCHANGED from the draft; the amendment path was evaluated and rejected: qualifying more combinations would require null_band >= 0.041, admitting instruments whose matched nulls show 0.045-0.56 spurious advantage, which would invalidate the privacy instrument's credibility. Qualification verdicts from calibration (strict, every seed): QUALIFIED = input_byte@inbound_gradients@{none,gradient-defense}, input_byte@outbound_gradients@{none,gradient-defense} (4 of 24). UNQUALIFIED = all forward_values and returned_values channels for every target, and all next_byte_class and punctuation_fraction combinations (20 of 24), predominantly on the null criterion. Consequence per protocol: exploratory privacy is UNDETERMINED for every cell unless a qualified gradient-channel breach rejects it; no scoped PASS is available under this instrument suite, and unqualified channels must be named in every report.
